title: Pre-Visit Clearance Age and Package Portal Bookings on Appointment Series
content:
Clinical Operations standard — how recent the pre-visit clearance on an Appointment Series must be for a larger package portal booking.

**Rule.** The package portal clearance limit is the maximum appointments in one booking of the series' format where the pre-visit clearance on the series is dated no more than 30 calendar days before the booking date, 6 appointments where it is dated more than 30 but no more than 90 days before, and 4 appointments where it is older or the series carries no clearance date.

**Record read.** The clearance date on the series record.

| Clearance date, calendar days before the booking date | Package portal clearance limit |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | the format's maximum appointments in one booking |
| 31 to 90 | 6 appointments |
| more than 90, or no clearance date | 4 appointments |

| Visit format | Maximum appointments in one booking |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 8 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 8 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 18 |

**Edges (hypothetical).** A clearance dated 30 days before the booking date on an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series gives 8; at 31 days, 6; at 90 days, 6; at 91 days, 4. A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series carrying no clearance date gives 4.
